name: Lord Geoffrey
source:
Marion knows him as Lord Geoffrey, the unwanted fiance from whom she's escaped. The people of Nottingham know him as "The Sheriff," their deeply unpopular ruler who strictly enforces Prince John's onerous tax laws. He is stern, cold, and haughty - but is there more to this man than meets the eye? What will Marion learn when she dons a clever disguise and enters his household not as a wife, but an employee and spy? Could she end up in the arms of the very man she once desperately fled?

Strengths: Logical, decisive, lacks prejudice
Flaws: Proud, overly stern, trusts no one

Likes: Law and order, competence, pragmatism
Dislikes: Sloppiness, sentimentality, Robin Hood
